text.text: Execution update -- status of plan rollout

*Completed*
• Plan posted (3/3 messages) to your Slack channel via the provided webhook
• 16 labels created in `DimonBel/Document-editor` (area/*, track/*, priority/P*, svc/*)
• 7 milestones created: M0 Foundations, M1 Containers, M2 Gateway (Python), M3 room-service, M4 doc-service, M5 latex-service, M6 E2E parity + cutover
• *47 GitHub issues created* (#18 through #64), each with the right labels, milestone, and a full body describing acceptance criteria. `gh issue list` confirms:
```
M0 Foundations:       10  (#18..#27)
M1 Containers:         7  (#28..#34)
M2 Gateway (Python):   9  (#35..#43)
M3 room-service:       6  (#44..#49)
M4 doc-service:        6  (#50..#55)
M5 latex-service:      6  (#56..#61)
M6 E2E parity + cutover: 3 (#62..#64)
```

Project-board setup is *blocked on your browser auth*. The current `gh` token only has scopes `gist, read:org, repo, workflow` -- the `project` + `read:project` scopes are needed for GitHub Projects V2.

*To finish*: open `https://github.com/login/device` in your browser and paste the code that the cli last printed (most recent: `D438-D522`). Once you've authorized, then run from the repo root:

```
python ".issues/setup_project.py"
```

That script creates a `Document-editor -- Backend Refactor` project, adds custom fields *Status / Track / Priority / Estimate*, and adds all 47 issues to the board with their `Backlog` + per-issue `Track` and `Priority` values.

*What's saved in the repo*
• `.slack-msg-1.json`, `.slack-msg-2.json`, `.slack-msg-3.json` -- the plan payload that was sent to Slack
• `.issues/issue-01.md` ... `.issues/issue-47.md` -- bodies of all 47 issues (full text, reviewable)
• `.issues/create_issues.py` -- idempotent: re-running it will fail on duplicates (issues already exist)
• `.issues/setup_project.py` -- ready to run once browser auth is complete

Every script is committed in `.issues/` so you can re-run, audit, or delete at any time.
